pool.sol: Since \(r = \dfrac{4}{8}h\), \(V=\dfrac{1}{3}\pi\left(\dfrac{4}{8}\right)^2h^3\). Differentiating and solving for \(\dfrac{dh}{dt}\) at \(h=7\) gives \(-\frac{24}{49}/\pi\) ft/min.
